fusions.name: Long Stillness Breaks
fusions.desc: After holding still for 1.2 seconds, you hurl a weight that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Shed-Tail Sweep
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Sweeps around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Sunned on the Slag
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Strength
fusions.desc: By day, your damage rises by 10%. Your armour rises by 5%.
